we propose to jointly learn geometry and motion with 3D holistic understanding, and achieve significant improvement on both tasks, which are two of the most challenging tasks in computer vision.

1) Our work is the first attempt to address 3D geometry estimation and motion understanding jointly; 2) Our method is able to disentangle the rigid background motion and the moving objects motion in the scene; 3) Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on all the five tasks of 3D geometry/motion estimation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by jointly modeling geometry and motion in a single network, one can achieve better performance for both tasks, compared to treating them independently.
, in the future, it is better to jointly model the 3D geometry of the scene and motion, instead of treating them as separate tasks.
the 3D geometry of a scene can be better understood by jointly learning with the motion information, and that every pixel counts.
